Sasha (People Ops): Quick update: we've revised the handbook section on benefits eligibility and dependent care reimbursement limits. Managers need to acknowledge the change and ensure their direct reports are aware. Deadline for manager ack: Fri 2026-04-30. Also launching a 20-min micro-course 'Benefits & Reimbursements Essentials'.
Ethan (Benefits): Handbook link: https://internal.handbook/benefits#dependent-care. Key change: max annual reimbursement increased to $1,200 and clarified documentation requirements.
Marta (Legal): Reviewed US/EU wording. Left one comment for Canada contractors re: tax reporting; will add suggested language in the doc. Changes are non-retroactive for reimbursements already processed.
Leo (Recruiting): We'll add a checklist item for hiring managers: "acknowledged benefits update" before manager start. I'll update the offer template today.
Ally (People Partner): If a manager is on leave during the window, note dates in the tracker and tag me. We'll mark those as exemptions.
Sasha (People Ops): Tracker + ack flow: https://sheets.redwood/benefits-acks. Managers: set "Acked" = Yes + date and complete the micro-course at https://learn.redwood/benefits-essentials (SSO auto-logs). If auto-log fails, paste a completion screenshot in the tracker.
PolicyBot: Reminder scheduled: Automated DM to managers without ack on Mon 2026-04-27 09:00 UTC.
Ethan (Benefits): Payroll note: the reimbursement cap takes effect for claims submitted after 2026-05-01. I'll post an FAQ in the tracker comments about receipts and allowable expenses.
Marta (Legal): For audits, we'll need manager-level completion records. Admins can export with the People Tools command:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://people-api/export?sheet=benefits-acks" > benefits_acks.csv
```
Sasha (People Ops): I'll prepare a 1-slide summary for manager meetings and post it in #management-resources by Wed. Ping me if you need a per-team CSV.
Leo (Recruiting): Noted  updating templates now.
Ally (People Partner): Running a pre-audit check on Tue 2026-05-04 and will share numbers with Compliance + People Ops.
Sasha (People Ops): Thanks team. Closing thread  will update if wording or timeline changes.
